note: Dated, expiring risk acceptances consumed by scripts/audit-check.mjs. Rationale and evidence for each entry live in SECURITY-AUDIT.md. Adding an entry here is a security decision and should be reviewed as one.

semantics.key: advisory + package. Duplicates are rejected, because a lookup over duplicates would make policy order-dependent.
semantics.approvedSeverity: Maximum. If the advisory is later reported at a higher severity the exception does not apply. `critical` can never be approved.
semantics.expires: EXCLUSIVE, YYYY-MM-DD, evaluated at 00:00 UTC. The exception applies while now < expires, so the date itself is the first day it no longer suppresses.
semantics.unused: FATAL. Every entry must correspond to a currently reported advisory. An unused but unexpired entry is dormant suppression authority: if a dependency change reintroduced the advisory it would be suppressed again with no human re-review. Delete entries when the advisory disappears.

exceptions.reason: Path traversal via sourceMappingURL auto-loading. Requires attacker-controlled CSS. Only first-party CSS is processed, at build time. Patched upstream in 8.5.18; our direct postcss is already 8.5.25, the exposed copy is the 8.4.31 pinned inside next.
Arbitrary file read via attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL. Same precondition and same dependency path as GHSA-r28c. Patched upstream in 8.5.12.

XSS via unescaped </style> in stringify output. Requires user-controlled CSS being parsed and stringified into HTML. This site has no user-supplied CSS and no runtime CSS processing. Patched upstream in 8.5.10.

Inherited libvips CVEs. Requires processing an untrusted image. next.config.mjs defines no remotePatterns, so next/image can only process the single repository-owned JPG. Patched upstream in 0.35.0; the exposed copy is 0.34.5 pinned inside next.

Memory-exhaustion DoS via unbounded expansion. Reached only through the ESLint 8 toolchain during lint and CI, and requires pathological glob patterns in our own configuration. Dev and CI only, not request-time reachable. Patched upstream in 5.0.8.
